findings: rm_util_list_foreach_remove updates previous next or list head but does not update surviving next->prev when deleting GList node. Subsequent backward traversal/removal may use stale linkage; caller reachability and original-function control still needed.
Singly linked removal maintains prev correctly; slist_pop uses supplied mutex when nonNULL. Queue concatenation transfers links and empties source, assumes distinct queues.
rm_util_get_groupname dereferences getpwuid result without NULL guard, unlike username helper. UID-not-in-database runtime case not tested.
User/group ID comparator subtracts unsigned IDs then returns int; wide ID difference can wrap/truncate and violate numeric ordering. Not equivalent to reviewed safe SIGN_DIFF.
ELF metadata path checks regular executable flag and opens path, but does not locally validate elf_begin or gelf_getshdr success before using section header. Backend behavior untested.
User/group list is snapshot at initialization and lookup protected by mutex; it does not automatically refresh account database.
Parent inode helper stats parent at call time and returns sentinel-1 on error without typed status, so consumers must interpret failure.
limits: Only utilities.c1-660 read; physical-disk logic starts after this segment and remains unread.
No runtime tests or own-library change. Native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
